units: <cite ref="Chullin 63a:16">Ḥull. 63ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00494"><he>דַּיָּה</he></cite>; <he>ולמה … ח׳ שעושה חסידות וכ׳</he> and she is named ‘the kind’ because she acts kindly with her kind; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 118:11">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 17</cite>.
